owner_tightening.t1_conversation_bound_context_wins: 遵守：I-1 invariant 确立——打开 Conversation 后其 storeId 为业务上下文事实源；ambient store selection 不得静默改变该会话的 Customer/Product/Order/Platform/AI context
owner_tightening.t2_all_stores_is_queue_scope: 遵守：I-2——All Stores 仅为 workspace/queue query scope，非 Store identity；未设计伪 storeId="all"；原则：All Stores is a work queue scope, not a data ownership scope
owner_tightening.t3_no_ai_auto_store_context: 遵守：DP-9 未使用 AI 自动决定店铺上下文语义；推荐 context-aware workspace + explicit professional store switcher；AI 可建议但不隐式改变 Store scope
owner_tightening.t4_dp11_rewritten: 遵守：DP-11 重写为 Store selection 对 workspace queue/filter 与 active Conversation 的作用关系；推荐 Store selection 过滤 workspace entry/queue，active Conversation 始终绑定自身 Store identity
owner_tightening.t5_dp12_preference_vs_fact: 遵守：DP-12 明确比较 navigation preference 与 business fact；推荐 explicit selection + optional remembered navigation preference；禁止 AI inferred automatic store switching；AI 切店建议需用户确认
owner_tightening.t6_platform_grouping_candidate: 遵守：全部/PDD/DouDian 仅作 platform-grouping candidate，未硬编码为永久 IA taxonomy；未来须支持可扩展 PlatformId
owner_tightening.t7_dp13_scope_vs_authority: 遵守：DP-13 推荐 merchant-wide Supervisor/Ops aggregate + Store/Platform filtering；可见范围由 Capability/ResourceScope 决定，IA 不授予 authority
owner_tightening.t8_dp14_no_ambiguous_cross_store_action: 遵守：新增 DP-14/UX invariant——任何 business-impacting action 必须明确 target Store；AI suggestion/action 不得混合不同 Store 事实上下文
owner_tightening.t9_dual_scope_model_discussed: 遵守：讨论 Agent Workspace 同时支持 All Stores queue scope 与 Specific Store scope 的模型；仅 IA proposal，未实现
owner_tightening.t10_no_code_change: 遵守：产品代码变更=0；未改 shop-sidebar / typed selection；未实现 queue / Command Palette / Phase 4 workflow
